Name: Stronger Hammers and Daggers
Author: Eldiran
Description:
Daggers and hammers are completely awful in the vanilla game. This mod makes the following changes:

All daggers deal double damage.
All hammers deal roughly +40% damage.

[b]IMPORTANT: these changes only affect NEW weapons. You must buy/find/cheat a new weapon to use its new damage value.[/b]

The mod has not been vetted for balance (although it should at least be less unbalanced than the default weapons).

[u]INSTALLATION:[/u]
- Go to Stardew Valley/Content/Data.
- Backup your weapons.xnb by renaming it to something else.
- Put the new weapons.xnb file there.

This mod is incompatible with other mods that replace weapons.xnb.
